headline: AB Enzymes shelf-life enzyme; FDA revokes color additive chemicals; Hovis 3-ingredient sourdough
summary: AB Enzymes launched Veron MaxiFresh, a maltogenic amylase for longer shelf life, which competes head-on with Puratos's anti-staling enzymes and improvers, so benchmark it with key industrial bakery accounts.
FDA revoked authorizations for certain chemicals used in food color additives, so US colored glazes, icings, fillings and decorations should be checked and reformulated where affected.
Hovis (three-ingredient sourdough answering UPF concerns) and Pepperidge Farm (sourdough cookies) show sourdough moving to short labels and sweet goods, an opening for Sapore.
Cocoa supply remains the watch point: Treefera's AI flags weather risk for 2027 while Ghana COCOBOD relaunches free fertilizer to lift output, both relevant to Belcolade sourcing.
ADM is betting on precision fermentation and Baker & Baker bought free-from brand Lazy Day Foods, signalling growing demand for animal-free and allergen-free bakery solutions.

items.title: New AB Enzymes ingredient extends shelf life in baked foods
items.summary: AB Enzymes launched Veron MaxiFresh, a maltogenic amylase that extends shelf life in baked goods.
items.why: A direct competitor to Puratos's anti-staling enzyme and improver range; benchmark performance and pricing for industrial bakery customers.

items.title: FDA Revokes Authorizations for Certain Chemicals Used in Food Color Additives
items.summary: FDA has revoked authorizations for certain chemicals used in food color additives.
items.why: Puratos's colored glazes, icings, fillings and decorations in the US need checking against the revoked substances and reformulating where affected.

items.title: Hovis Launches Three-Ingredient Sourdough Range In Tesco
items.summary: Hovis launched a three-ingredient sourdough range in Tesco.
items.why: A major UK baker is pushing short-label sourdough, raising demand for clean-label fermentation solutions like Sapore.

items.title: Hovis responds to UPF concerns with three-ingredient sourdough range
items.summary: Hovis positions its new three-ingredient sourdough range as a response to ultra-processed food (UPF) concerns.
items.why: UPF pressure is pushing industrial bakers to strip ingredient lists; Puratos should be ready with sourdough and enzyme solutions that deliver short labels.

items.title: Treefera CEO: AI flags cocoa supply risks as weather pressures cloud 2027 outlook
items.summary: Treefera's CEO says its AI satellite monitoring flags cocoa supply risks, with weather clouding the 2027 outlook.
items.why: AI supply-risk tools like Treefera's could help Belcolade's sourcing team anticipate 2027 cocoa shortfalls; possible partner.

items.title: Professional Sensory Screening for Hypothesis-Generating Gastronomic Research: An Action Case of Wholegrain Flour Milling and Sourdough Bread
items.summary: Örebro University tested 12 artisan sourdough breads from Swedish wheat landraces and spelt under four milling methods using a professional sensory panel; sifted flours gave airy, elastic crumb while stone-milled wholegrain gave stronger cereal and roasted notes.
items.why: Useful sensory evidence on heritage grains and milling for Puratos's sourdough and wholegrain ranges and Taste Tomorrow insight.

items.title: Scottish Free-From Plant-Based Brand Lazy Day Foods Snapped Up by Baker & Baker
items.summary: Baker & Baker has acquired Scottish free-from, plant-based bakery brand Lazy Day Foods to expand in Europe.
items.why: A frozen-bakery customer/competitor is buying into allergen-free plant-based sweet goods, signalling demand for Puratos's egg- and dairy-free solutions.

items.title: Regional distribution and soil extractability of cadmium in cacao systems across the Cordillera subregion of Nariño in Colombia
items.summary: AGROSAVIA mapped cadmium in cacao soils and beans across 143 farms in Nariño, Colombia, finding 20% of bean samples above 0.6 mg/kg and linking soil pH and minerals to uptake.
items.why: Cadmium limits (EU) make Colombian origin sourcing a compliance risk for Belcolade; the soil factors suggest mitigation levers to discuss with suppliers.

items.title: ADM sees precision fermentation as next growth phase
items.summary: ADM says precision fermentation is its next growth phase.
items.why: A major ingredient supplier scaling precision fermentation could supply animal-free dairy and egg proteins for Puratos's bakery and patisserie lines, or compete with them.

items.title: Fi Europe 2026 preview: Clean label reformulation meets the sensory challenge
items.summary: Fi Europe 2026 preview on how clean-label reformulation is colliding with sensory expectations.
items.why: Clean-label taste trade-offs are the core problem Puratos's enzyme, sourdough and flavour solutions address; useful for trade-show positioning.

items.title: Simultaneous extraction of cocoa butter and antioxidants from defective cocoa beans by natural deep eutectic solvents
items.summary: Chulalongkorn University used a natural deep eutectic solvent to extract cocoa butter and phenolic antioxidants together from defective, under-fermented cocoa beans.
items.why: An upcycling route for off-grade beans could stretch cocoa butter supply amid high prices; worth tracking for Belcolade sustainability.

items.title: Ghana COCOBOD relaunches free fertilizer programme to boost cocoa production
items.summary: Ghana COCOBOD is relaunching a free fertilizer programme to raise cocoa output.
items.why: Higher Ghanaian yields would ease cocoa supply pressure for Belcolade over the next seasons.

items.title: Pepperidge Farm Launches First-of-Its-Kind Sourdough Cookies
items.summary: Pepperidge Farm launched sourdough cookies, which it calls a first of its kind.
items.why: Sourdough is moving into sweet goods in mainstream US retail, an opening for Puratos's Sapore sourdough in cookies and pastries.

items.title: Trust Tapioca Fiber
items.summary: Sponsored piece promoting a clean-label tapioca fiber for formulation and fibre enrichment.
items.why: A clean-label fibre option relevant to Puratos's fibre-enrichment and sugar-reduction work in bakery.

items.title: Mondelēz shifts strategy to drive growth
items.summary: Mondelēz is chasing growth through share gains, emerging markets, affordability-focused innovation and distribution.
items.why: A leading chocolate and biscuit maker focusing on affordability signals demand for cost-efficient chocolate and filling solutions.

items.title: US midterms: Should European bakers build or ship?
items.summary: European bakers weigh building US plants versus exporting amid tariff uncertainty after the midterms.
items.why: Shifts by European bakers into US production could create new North American customers for Puratos's Pennsauken-led operations.

items.title: Pandan trends in global flavors
items.summary: US new product claims promoting pandan flavour rose 53% between early 2025 and mid-2026.
items.why: Pandan is a fast-rising flavour for fillings, creams and cakes; a candidate for new Puratos patisserie flavours.

items.title: UK–EU SPS Agreement: Implications for Food Safety Regulations, Trade, and Compliance
items.summary: Analysis of the UK–EU sanitary and phytosanitary (SPS) agreement and its effects on food safety rules, trade and compliance.
items.why: Puratos's UK–EU flows of ingredients and chocolate may face simpler checks; trade and regulatory teams should review the agreement terms.
